provider_receipt.summary: Review found unsupported completion and named defects: (1) src/lib.rs:56-89 MemoryStore::store only serializes a MemoryRecord into a discarded local variable, so scan_vault provides no persistent memory integration despite the stated purpose. (2) src/lib.rs:13-25 and fixtures use a legacy frontmatter shape incompatible with docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:71-93; required authority, privacy, provenance, review, supersession, and contract fields are neither represented nor validated, and confidence is numeric instead of low/medium/high. Consequently src/lib.rs:106-125 ingests every Markdown note without the required classification, privacy, authority, or canonicality controls. (3) src/lib.rs:184-192 accepts absolute and parent-traversing wikilinks; PathBuf::join can resolve outside the vault, and src/lib.rs:174-175 exposes an existing external path as a backlink. (4) src/lib.rs:110-114 silently discards WalkDir errors, allowing incomplete scans to report success. (5) The durable parent evidence establishes only a clean tree and index/document inspection; it contains no functional or security verification supporting approval of this implementation.
